testFuzz_cannotWithdrawMoreThanDeposited.details: Run against the FIXED vault: this is the property the fixes are supposed to      restore.

test_bugA_oneWeiDrainRevertsOnFixedVault.details: `previewWithdraw` now rounds up, so one wei costs at least one share, and the      `maxWithdraw` check rejects a zero-share caller before that with a named error.

test_bugA_oneWeiDrainWorksOnBrokenVault(.details: The setup is a vault where one share is worth exactly two asset units, which makes      `convertToShares(1) == 0` by truncation. The attacker holds NO shares at all and      still gets paid, because `_burn(attacker, 0)` succeeds against a zero balance.

test_bugC_erc777ReentrancyDrainsBrokenVa.details: Full mechanism is documented on `ReentrancyAttacker`. In short: `redeem` pays out      before it burns, so during the `tokensReceived` callback the vault holds 900e18      assets while still reporting 1,000e18 shares outstanding. The attacker deposits the      assets it was just paid at that fake 0.9 price, mints 111.1e18 shares instead of      100e18, and the outer burn only removes 100e18 of them.

test_bugC_erc777ReentrancyFailsOnFixedVa.details: Two independent reasons: `_burn` happens before the transfer so the price during      the callback is correct, and `nonReentrant` rejects the nested `deposit` outright.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

testFuzz_cannotWithdrawMoreThanDeposited.notice: A user can never take out more of the underlying than they put in.

test_bugA_oneWeiDrainRevertsOnFixedVault.notice: The identical sequence reverts on the fixed vault.

test_bugA_oneWeiDrainWorksOnBrokenVault(.notice: Numeric proof that the 1-wei drain works on the broken vault.

test_bugC_erc777ReentrancyDrainsBrokenVa.notice: The ERC-777 reentrancy exploit succeeds against the broken vault and the         attacker walks away with roughly 10% more than they put in.

test_bugC_erc777ReentrancyFailsOnFixedVa.notice: The identical exploit contract fails against the fixed vault.
